rules.description: Every selected workflow exists in the registry and is stable.
Every action a workflow references exists and is available.
Every LINE entry's action accepts LINE invocation and the action input schema is valid.
Sheets each action needs are provided by the workflow's spreadsheet schemas.
Every spreadsheet schema a workflow references exists.
All sheets required by selected workflows are present in the project schema.
Columns have valid types, enums have values, defaults match types.
No sheet defines the same column twice.
Primary keys and indexes name real columns; references resolve inside the project schema.
Required CONFIG keys have a value in the brief (otherwise the owner must fill them in).
Every module file and generated file exists in the GAS project.
Every relative import inside gas/src and gas/tests resolves.
Generated action registry covers exactly the selected workflows' actions.
The GAS project contains tests for every included module plus the generated wiring test.
tsc --noEmit passes for the GAS project.
vitest passes for the GAS project.
esbuild bundle builds and exposes top-level doGet/doPost/setupSpreadsheet/setupRichMenu.
Size meets LINE limits; areas are inside the canvas and do not overlap; at most 20 areas.
Every workflow button references a selected workflow and an existing entry; URI buttons resolve to https URLs.
Every button has a label and every layout slot has a button.
Every selected workflow is reachable from at least one button.
Postback data is at most 300 characters.
Label colors meet WCAG AA (4.5:1) against their tile colors.
No tokens, channel secrets, private keys or .clasp.json in the project.
No personal email addresses outside example domains in generated code or tests.
SETUP.md, DELIVERY.md and QA_REPORT.md exist and are non-empty.
Every artifact listed in project.json exists.
Every generated JSON artifact carries _meta with project, industry, workflows and asset versions.
